subject: Deflake BgIterationTest.createAndCleanup (#4714)
reason: The change modifies only src/unit/test_bgiteration.cpp, loosening a timing assertion (runtime_ms < 5 to < 1000) in the BgIterationTest.createAndCleanup unit test to deflake it in CI. It is a test-only change with no effect on Valkey server behavior, commands, replication, persistence, or tools, so there is no changed runtime path for a fuzzer scenario to reach.
